levels.name: Recognise
levels.criteria: Identify भाव और विचार की समझ in a chapter-related example.

levels.name: Explain
levels.criteria: Explain शब्दार्थ और संदर्भ using original wording and relevant evidence.

levels.name: Apply
levels.criteria: Use पाठ से प्रमाण to solve or interpret a new but related situation.

levels.name: Analyse
levels.criteria: Compare evidence, identify relationships and justify a conclusion about 'मीरा के पद'.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.criteria: Create a new example, question, model or explanation that demonstrates भाषिक अभिव्यक्ति.
